_comment: Branch protection ruleset for the main branch. Applied via scripts/apply-ruleset.sh. Rules marked _staged:true represent target-state checks not yet ready to be managed from this checked-in config; apply-ruleset.sh and check-ruleset.yml filter them out of config-driven apply/drift checks for now, and any currently live rules of those staged types may be retained until the staged config is promoted. The CI pipeline checks (🚀 CI Pipeline / lint|format|build|test|custom-checks) are in the active required_status_checks rule because they are ALREADY LIVE in the GitHub ruleset — the CI pipeline refactor (ci-orchestrator.yml + ci-pipeline.yml) added them to the live ruleset before this config was updated to track them.
name: Protect Main

rules._comment: Prevent force pushes to main — history must be linear and immutable.
Prevent direct deletion of the main branch.

Require a pull request before merging into main. required_approving_review_count:0 is intentional — the merge gate is the bot-review required status check (commit status set by the Code Reviewer Bot), not GitHub's formal approving-review count. require_code_owner_review:true enforces .github/CODEOWNERS, requiring @bkrupa approval on sensitive paths (auth, payments, migrations, CI, terraform) — enabled in T17 (LS-3998). dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push:true ensures the bot's APPROVE is dismissed on every new push, forcing re-review of each HEAD SHA (LS-3977).

Require bot approval, conflict-free state, and passing CI before merging. bot-review is a commit status (not a check run) set via the GitHub Statuses API by the Code Reviewer Bot (.github/scripts/reviewer/lib/github.mjs:setCommitStatus). The CI Pipeline checks are composite names generated by GitHub from the workflow_call relationship between ci-orchestrator.yml (outer job: '🚀 CI Pipeline') and ci-pipeline.yml (inner jobs: lint, format, etc.) — they cannot be matched to a single workflow job by required-checks-lint.mjs. The _commitStatus and _calledWorkflow markers are stripped by apply-ruleset.sh before sending to the API. strict_required_status_checks_policy:false (LS-4183): the up-to-date-with-base sub-policy is intentionally disabled to allow merge-queue throughput. With strict=true the queue had to call pulls.updateBranch() on every behind PR, creating Merge-main commits and serializing all merges (~1 PR per CI cycle). Trade-off accepted: the rare semantic-conflict class (textually-disjoint PRs that combine to break main) is caught by post-merge CI on main rather than blocked pre-merge. Textual conflicts are still blocked unconditionally by mergeable:false.

required_status_checks._comment: Commit status set to pending/success/failure by the Code Reviewer Bot (.github/scripts/reviewer/index.mjs). Not a check run — no matching workflow job name.
Fails if the PR branch has merge conflicts with the base branch (check-conflicts.yml).

Verifies all migration files in lib/db-client/migrations/ are applied to the production RDS before merge. Blocks PRs that add a migration file without running it first. Defined in check-migrations-applied.yml; runs on every PR (no paths filter) so this required check always fires. LS-4843.

ESLint job in ci-pipeline.yml, surfaced as a composite check via workflow_call from ci-orchestrator.yml. Context name = outer job display name + ' / ' + inner job name. integration_id:15368 (GitHub Actions) is required so the ruleset evaluator matches the check-run; without it, GitHub shows 'Expected — Waiting for status to be reported' despite CI passing (LS-4345).
Prettier formatting job in ci-pipeline.yml, surfaced via workflow_call from ci-orchestrator.yml. integration_id:15368 required for ruleset check-run matching (LS-4345).
Build job (apps, lambdas, libraries) in ci-pipeline.yml, surfaced via workflow_call from ci-orchestrator.yml. integration_id:15368 required for ruleset check-run matching (LS-4345).
Unit/integration test job in ci-pipeline.yml, surfaced via workflow_call from ci-orchestrator.yml. integration_id:15368 required for ruleset check-run matching (LS-4345).

Custom checks job (migration immutability, schema drift, skill linting) in ci-pipeline.yml, surfaced via workflow_call from ci-orchestrator.yml. integration_id:15368 required for ruleset check-run matching (LS-4345).
